description: This file contains the implementation of the ZipStream class, which is responsible for creating streamed, dynamically generated ZIP archives. The class provides methods to add files from various sources, manage ZIP file structure, and handle streaming output, including support for ZIP64 and HTTP headers.
published: ZipStream\(class, constants, methods like addFile, finish)

classes.name: ZipStream
classes.description: Class responsible for creating streamed ZIP archives with support for large files, HTTP streaming, and ZIP64 extensions.

classes.name: Bigint
classes.description: Referenced within the class for handling large offset and length values within ZIP structures.

classes.name: File
classes.description: Represents individual files added to the ZIP archive, responsible for processing data and paths.

classes.name: DeflateStream
classes.description: Wraps stream resources for compression when adding files from streams.

classes.name: ArchiveOptions
classes.description: Configuration options for the archive, such as headers, HTTP options, large file support, etc.

classes.name: FileOptions
classes.description: Configuration options specific to individual files added to the ZIP archive.

classes.name: Version
classes.description: Defines software version constants used in ZIP structures.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new ZipStream object with optional filename and archive options.

methods.name: addFile
methods.description: Adds a file's contents directly to the ZIP archive.

methods.name: addFileFromPath
methods.description: Adds a file from the specified path to the ZIP archive, with optional file options.

methods.name: addFileFromStream
methods.description: Adds a file to the archive from a stream resource.

methods.name: addFileFromPsr7Stream
methods.description: Adds a file from a PSR-7 stream to the archive.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Finalizes the ZIP archive, writing necessary footers and handling ZIP64 if needed.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Outputs a string to the stream, sending HTTP headers if required.
